reasons.in_the_past: A meeting cannot start more than 14 days ago.
reasons.start_not_on_five: A meeting starts on a multiple of 5 minutes, for example 10:00 or 10:05.
reasons.minutes_not_attending: The person for the minutes must be the organizer or an attendee.
reasons.attendee_agent: An agent cannot attend a meeting. Choose a person.
reasons.title_hidden: Write the title on one line, with visible characters only.
reasons.project_fixed: A meeting stays in its project. Cancel it and plan a new one.
reasons.window_too_long: A list of meetings covers at most 400 days.
reasons.window_reversed: The end of the period comes before its start.
reasons.project_needed: A list of meetings that are not yours needs a project.
reasons.meeting_cancelled: This meeting is cancelled. It cannot change.
reasons.meeting_over: This meeting is over. Only its notes change.
